sections.content: Players 12 and under can use BravoBall only with a parent's or guardian's permission.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.content: The parent's email address and the child's first name or nickname, only to ask for permission; once approved, the child's training answers (position, age range, skill level, goals, equipment, schedule) and training activity (sessions, drills, streaks, progress).

sections.title: How we use it
sections.content: Only to provide personalized soccer training. We don't send a child's information to analytics or advertising companies. Children are hidden from the public leaderboard by default, friend features are off, and they can join a coach's team.

sections.title: If a parent doesn't approve
sections.content: If they decline or don't respond within 7 days, we delete the account, the parent's email and the child's name.

sections.title: Parents' rights
sections.content: You can revoke permission and delete your child's account at any time with the link in your confirmation email, or email team@conklinofficial.com to review or delete your child's information or to refuse further collection.
The full privacy policy is also in the BravoBall app under Profile → Privacy Policy.
